capabilities: Sync Obsidian checkbox tasks with a Dainvo account and Dainvo mobile
Complete, reopen, create and delete tasks from Dainvo with queued write-back to Markdown
Preserve task hierarchy, priorities, tags and due dates in snapshots
Pair with Dainvo desktop for planning, Daily Notes, project notes and item notes
Add stable task markers (^d- IDs) so tasks stay identifiable when moved
extras: The README includes detailed privacy and network disclosures (task metadata only, no note bodies, WebSocket notification channel), and warns that a stable marker such as ^d-A7k2Pq is inserted into task lines. Cloud relay and Dainvo accounts are third-party services; Obsidian has not manually reviewed the plugin.
problem: Checkbox tasks written in Obsidian Markdown are hard to see and complete from a phone, and there is no built-in way to keep them in sync with a companion planner app.

relations.evidence: Syncs normal Obsidian checkbox tasks with Dainvo.
Completing a recurring (🔁) task uses the Tasks plugin 7.2.0 or later when it is installed

summary: Task sync plugin that relays Obsidian checkbox tasks to a Dainvo account, viewable and editable in Dainvo mobile, with optional pairing to Dainvo desktop.
